expected_root_cause: The namespace's ResourceQuota limits pods to 1, but the sample-app Deployment requests 3 replicas. Only 1 pod is actually created; the ReplicaSet controller fails to create the remaining 2 because the quota is exceeded. This shows up as a FailedCreate event on the ReplicaSet, not on any pod, since the extra pods are never created at all.
key_evidence: get_events shows a FailedCreate event on the ReplicaSet mentioning exceeded quota
The Deployment/ReplicaSet shows desired=3 replicas but only 1 ready/available
should_not_conclude: The extra pods are crashlooping or failing health checks
Insufficient node CPU or memory capacity
